messages:
alex_finance: FYI we received invoice AC-2025-0214 from ApacheCloud for $48,320 (Feb usage). No PO attached in Coupa and payment run is scheduled for tomorrow EOD. Who owns this expense?

emma_ops: ack saw it in the inbox. i tried searching by vendor name and amount but nothing matched. can you paste the invoice PDF link?

alex_finance: link: https://files.redwood/example/AC-2025-0214.pdf

liam_infra: likely for dedicated GPU pool — tagging @sophia_procure since procurement usually manages ApacheCloud contracts.

sophia_procure: i don't see a live PO for that invoice number. the closest PO we have for ApacheCloud is PO-AP-2024-09 (reserved capacity) and it's for $120k/quarter, not a monthly break-out.

alex_finance: Coupa lookup returned: "no matching PO found". I pasted the vendor invoice metadata into the Coupa search (vendor: apachecloud, invoice_number: AC-2025-0214).

CoupaBot: System notice: Invoice AC-2025-0214 created by alex_finance. Matching rules: vendor+invoice_number -> no match. Attempted fuzzy match on amount/date -> candidate PO PO-AP-2024-09 (confidence 42%).

emma_ops: 42% confidence is low. we need an approver route. if it's tied to infra, approver should be liam or infra director. if procurement confirms contract, they can route to budget owner.

liam_infra: confirming with infra lead now. quick check: can we hold payment short window? payment team cutoffs are strict but finance can request a three-day hold if dispute exists.

alex_finance: we can request hold, but vendor is flagging late fee at 2% monthly. vendor relationships are fragile. sophia, can procurement confirm whether this is a one-off usage charge or part of the reserved PO?

sophia_procure: reached out to our ApacheCloud rep. they responded: "This invoice is for overage of reserved capacity for Feb — not included in the base PO. Overage invoices are billed monthly and require a separate PO or approval."

alex_finance: ok that explains mismatch. we need a short-form PO or approver routing to pay this month. suggested routing: 1) create PO-AP-2025-02-OVR for overage (procurement) OR 2) manager approval email from infra + procurement to finance. which is faster?

liam_infra: manager approval email is fastest. i'll get infra director to approve via Slack thread and cc procurement.

emma_ops: finance needs explicit approver name and amount in thread (for audit) and confirmation that cost center is INFRA-GPU.

liam_infra: @nora_dir — Nora, can you approve $48,320 for ApacheCloud overage (cost center INFRA-GPU) so finance can release payment this run?

nora_dir: I approve the payment of $48,320 for ApacheCloud overage (INFRA-GPU). Please ensure procurement files an overage PO for records.

emma_ops: noted. sophia_procure, can you create PO-AP-2025-02-OVR and attach to invoice in Coupa? if you need any details, alex will provide PDF and vendor contact.

sophia_procure: will create PO and attach. ETA 2 business hours. will upload to Coupa and link to invoice.

alex_finance: perfect. i'll mark invoice for payment release after PO is linked. adding note to the record: vendor requested expedited payment to avoid late fee.

CoupaBot: Action logged: PO PO-AP-2025-02-OVR created by sophia_procure and linked to invoice AC-2025-0214. Audit note added: approver nora_dir (Slack confirmation).

alex_finance: closing loop — payment will proceed in today's batch. thanks all.

liam_infra: thx :thumbsup:

emma_ops: filing the dispute/overage category for spend analytics so we can adjust forecasting.

sophia_procure: i'll follow up with vendor to clarify future overage billing cadence and update contract terms to require pre-approval for >$25k monthly overages.

alex_finance: end of thread.
